title: Same-Day Cancellation Fee Entries on an Appointment Series — Action Reference
content:
Action reference, Patient Services Center systems.

## Where the fee applies

A same-day cancellation fee on an Appointment Series is charged where the patient, not the clinic, cancelled a booked appointment on the appointment day itself, ahead of its start, and it is charged as a late cancellation; it is worked out on the most recent cancellation recorded on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date. It is booked as one same-day cancellation fee entry on the series, tied to the recorded cancellation it is for, in US dollars to the cent.

## When it is charged and settled

A same-day cancellation fee is not charged until every no-show on the series' first appointment recorded within its fee assessment period shows a first-appointment no-show fee entry.

The same-day cancellation fee is fixed only after every late arrival beyond the grace period recorded on the series as a zero-notice cancellation within its fee assessment period carries its late-arrival fee entry.

## The action: `assess_same_day_cancellation_fee_8648d00e`

**Capability.** The tool charges the same-day cancellation fee for one booked appointment the patient cancelled on the appointment day itself, ahead of its start time. One call books one late-cancellation-kind fee against the patient's appointment series, tied to the recorded cancellation it is for, and raises the missed-visit fees owed on that series by the amount charged. The patient sees the fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement. The tool records what it is given; it makes no judgement of its own.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_same_day_cancellation_fee_8648d00e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `series_id` | the reference number of the patient's appointment series that carries the cancelled appointment, as returned by the appointment series lookup | text identifier |
| `source_event_id` | the reference number of the recorded same-day cancellation entry the fee is for, as returned by the appointment history lookup for that series | text identifier |
| `amount` | the fee to charge, in USD | a positive number given to 2 decimal places (cents); stored exactly as passed after rounding to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** `fee_reference` (the reference number of the new fee entry; its presence means the fee was booked), `series_id` (the series charged), `fee_kind` (always `late_cancellation`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the missed appointment), `assessed_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee was charged) and `missed_fee_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the missed-visit fees owed on the series once this fee is included). No error return is defined.
